BiblicalUsage: Meshezabeel = "God delivers"; 1) ancestor of Meshullam who assisted Nehemiah in rebuilding the wall of Jerusalem; 1a) perhaps the same as 2 and 3; 2) a head of the people who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah; 2a) perhaps the same as 1 and 3; 3) father of Pethahiah and descendant of Zerah the son of Judah; 3a) perhaps the same as 1 and 2
